scope: offline reduced CT appendix contact coupon; not Isaac runtime, not force calibration, not surgical validation

matched_protocol.tool_geometry: two kinematic 3 mm radius spheres at 40% and 75% of appendix-axis length
matched_protocol.tool_path: same scripted 9 mm approach, hold and retreat for every material; contact-enabled and contact-disabled matched runs
matched_protocol.contact_material: Newton soft contact, mu=0.5; not a CAD jaw or friction-grasp model
matched_protocol.boundary: proximal CT-anchor neighborhood pinned; gravity support plane
matched_protocol.health_sampling: every 60 Hz control frame, not every internal solver substep

material_sources.interpretation: small-strain isotropic equivalent of ex-vivo 1 Hz, 1% shear storage modulus; not measured Young modulus, not fitted constitutive response

results.overall_status: passed numerical-health checks in the existing matched coupon
failed; both matched runs inverted tetrahedra

numerical_sensitivity_followups.interpretation: failed; doubling VBD iterations reduced inverted count from 9 to 8 but did not stabilize contact, and minimum signed-volume ratio worsened
failed; halving the time step modestly reduced inverted count from 9 to 7 and improved the minimum volume ratio, but did not prevent inversion

force_measurement.reason: The coupon reports deformation and element health only; its kinematic-sphere contact response is not instrumented as an independently verified force sensor.

interpretation: The lower literature-scaled scalar moduli are not stable in this fixed-mesh, fixed-boundary Newton contact setup; do not swap them into production or RL assets.

The failures identify a solver/material compatibility problem for this coupon. They do not refute the human rheology measurements and do not prove that a nonlinear, viscoelastic, layered tissue model would fail.
Reported contact-induced displacement is a numerical response, not a biological target value.
privacy: Only mesh hash and aggregate solver metrics are tracked. CT-derived mesh files, simulation traces and point arrays remain local and git-ignored.
limitations: Voxelized reduced mesh, not the production deformable mesh
Isotropic linear-elastic VBD material with no measured loss modulus, rate dependence, compression stiffening, tearing or disease heterogeneity
Spherical kinematic contacts, not instrument CAD or trocar-constrained arms
No physical force-displacement ground truth and no runtime Isaac integration
Health checks sample control frames, not every solver substep
